t: Printable or digital cards that teach AI vocabulary with short activities.
steps: Go to dayofai.org and find the Vocabulary Cards page.
Register or log in. The page says a login is needed to view all resources.
Download the cards and the Educator Guide.
Decide between print and digital use.
Print and cut the cards for a center, or load them on a classroom screen.
Choose a 5 to 15 minute activity from the guide.
Check the age range on the page. The sources give different grades.
